title: Price-Volume Correlations Are Always Zero
abstract: arXiv:2611.08528v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We argue that the use of the empirical time series of values, volumes, and prices of consecutive trades made during the averaging interval to calculate the price-volume correlation in a way that follows the definition of correlation always gives zero correlation. We show that the usual expression for the empirical calculation of the correlation misleads the researchers and doesn't fulfill the definition of price-volume correlation. The mistake has its origin in the dependence of volume weighted average price on the mean values and volumes of trades during the averaging interval but not on time series of prices only. translated_title: 价格-成交量相关性恒为零
translated_abstract: 我们论证了在平均区间内使用连续交易的数值、成交量和价格的经验时间序列，并按照相关性的定义来计算价格-成交量相关性时，总是只会得到零相关性。我们表明，通常用于经验计算相关性的表达式会误导研究者，且并不符合价格-成交量相关性的定义。这一错误的根源在于，成交量加权平均价格取决于平均区间内交易的均值和成交量，而不仅仅取决于价格的时间序列。众多研究者通过经验计算所宣称的价格-成交量相关性的正值或负值结果，其真正的含义实际上是由成交量加权平均价格与其极限表达式（即平均价格）之间的差异所决定的，而后者仅在所有连续交易的成交量（相等时）才正确。
tldr: 该论文证明，按照相关性的定义使用交易价格与成交量的经验时间序列计算价格-成交量相关性时，结果恒为零，而以往文献中报告的正负相关性实际上源于成交量加权平均价与算术平均价之间的差异。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that calculating price-volume correlations from empirical time series of trade prices and volumes according to the standard correlation definition always yields zero, and the positive or negative correlations previously reported actually arise from the difference between the volume-weighted average price and the arithmetic average price.
